# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Matuni gukui naji Ghalaghwasha ma naghwamalé má natunanamighzeja (y adorarte) matuni gukwa ghaika gwásu nituku, má ghamamekwa yá daznada nashi dazna gháwia, ayzc nadaki yá Ghalaghwasha yónagholija niashi yónghwapa.
